title: WeCom receive connections
boundary: Receive-only, quarantined feedback. No replies, test sends, model calls or global worker controls.
noReplay: No replay or historical completeness guarantee. A gap flag is not repaired by refreshing.
denied: Access or read failed. Private data and controls are hidden; sign in with an authorized administrator session.
limit: At most 100 connections, newest created first. Redacted status only; configuration cannot be reconstructed or edited here.
enableWarning: Enabling CAN CONNECT to WeCom and receive allowed messages when global worker gates permit. This is not a connection test or proof of delivery.
disableWarning: Disabling stops this receive connection. In-flight work may settle; missing messages cannot be replayed.
confirmChange: I explicitly confirm this enable/disable operation.
registrar: Only an instance administrator may register. The server checks current authority and Bot ownership must be verified separately. Company administrators manage existing connections.
scopeHelp: One explicit ID per line, maximum 100 each. At least one group or direct sender is required; no wildcard or all-history scope.
pinHelp: Only active, undeleted company secrets. The number is a frozen pin, never a moving latest reference. The server validates version status; no secret value is loaded or created.
confirmRegister: I verified ownership and scopes and confirm registration DISABLED, without connecting.
registered: Registered disabled. No connection was started by registration.
updated: State saved. Refresh to inspect worker status; not a delivery guarantee.
rejected: Request rejected. Review current state and authority before any new operation.
unknown: Response uncertain: do NOT repeat the POST. Refresh manually and reconcile with an administrator. Redacted lists cannot prove Bot identity; no configuration details are available here.
